3GPP TSG-RAN WG2 Meeting #132 R2-2509362 Dallas, USA, 17 – 21 November 2025 Title: LS on MPDCCH narrowband selection for CB-Msg3-EDT Response to: - Release: Release 19 Work Item: IoT_NTN_Ph3-Core Source: TSG RAN WG2 To: TSG RAN WG1 Cc: Contact Person: Name: Ping Yuan E-mail Address: Ping.1.yuan@nokia-sbell.com Send any reply LS to: 3GPP Liaisons Coordinator, mailto:3GPPLiaison@etsi.org Attachments: - 1. Overall Description: During RAN2#132 meeting, RAN2 further discussed how to support 2 MPDCCH narrowbands for CB-Msg4 monitoring and achieved the following agreement regarding MPDCCH narrowband selection.
